ui.tagline: A tiny YouTube Music player for {os}.

overlay.title: OBS overlay
overlay.desc: Now-playing card for an OBS Browser Source.
overlay.hint: In OBS: Add → Browser Source → paste the URL (card about 480×140, compact 480×100).

update.title: Updates
update.body: Takaro {latest} is available. You have {current}. Update now? The app restarts on its own.
update.bodyManual: Takaro {latest} is available. You have {current}. Download it and install it over this version.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.note: Install extensions from the Chrome Web Store or Edge Add-ons. Extensions that change pages (blockers, themes, tweaks) work best; toolbar popups aren't available in Takaro.
extensions.installed: {name} installed. Reload Takaro to use it.
extensions.updated: {name} updated. Reload Takaro to use it.

sponsorblock.name: SponsorBlock
sponsorblock.description: Skips intros, outros and non-music parts of music videos, using the SponsorBlock database.

options.applyOnce: Only for the first song after opening the app

resume-session.name: Resume last session
resume-session.description: When the app opens, goes back to the song, playlist or mix you were listening to, at the same point.

options.restoreTime: Resume from where the song stopped

precise-volume.name: Precise volume
precise-volume.description: Change the volume with the mouse wheel over the player bar and with the ↑/↓ arrow keys.

options.arrowsShortcut: Use the ↑/↓ arrow keys for volume

playback-speed.name: Playback speed
playback-speed.description: Adds a speed control (0.25× to 2×) to the ⋮ menu of the player bar. Use the mouse wheel for fine adjustments.
playback-speed.label: Speed

quality-changer.name: Quality selector
quality-changer.description: Adds a button over the player to choose the video/audio quality.

video-toggle.name: Video or cover
video-toggle.description: Choose what the player shows: the music video, only the cover art, or nothing at all.

display.hidden: Nothing (hide the player, queue on full page)

player-background.name: Player background
player-background.description: The cover art of the current song, blurred, as the backdrop behind the player.

player-bar.name: Player bar
player-bar.description: Customize the bar at the bottom of the window.

options.glass: Glass bar (see-through, frosted bar and menus)
options.center: Center buttons (playback controls in the middle, song info on the left)

lyrics.name: Synced lyrics
lyrics.description: Time-synced lyrics in the Lyrics tab (Better Lyrics, LRCLIB). Click a line to jump to it.

options.autoOpen: Open the Lyrics tab when lyrics are found

share-links.name: Takaro links
share-links.description: Adds “Copy Takaro link” to the player's ⋮ menu. tak:// links open the song straight in Takaro.

toast-autoclose.name: Auto-close notifications
toast-autoclose.description: Closes YouTube Music's pop-up notifications (like “Saved to liked music”) after a few seconds.

performance.name: Performance fixes
performance.description: Lowers YouTube Music's CPU use (CPU Tamer). Turn off if something misbehaves.

adblock.name: Ad blocker
adblock.description: Removes YouTube Music's ads using uBlock Origin's filter lists (downloaded by the app and updated daily). Turn off if you have YouTube Premium.

options.trackers: Block trackers (telemetry and ad tracking; your history keeps working)
options.autoSkip: Skip ads automatically (when one still gets through)
